purpose: Review synchronized Tesla Fleet Charging business-account sessions, costs, energy, charging sites and independent site wait forecasts.
primaryGoal: Scope fleet charging history, understand cost and energy evidence, inspect session records and export them without losing source identity, currency or missing-data semantics.

dataSources.name: Fleet sessions and lifetime summary
dataSources.behavior: VIN query key, SLOW staleTime, enabled after vehicle loading, AbortSignal forwarded; response supplies sessions and an independent summary. No date bounds in read hook.
dataSources.backendLimits: Router matches the hook path. Backend filtering, result completeness, ordering, units of legacy power/rate fields and summary calculations were not inspected or exercised.

dataSources.name: Business-account import
dataSources.behavior: Hook accepts vin/date_from/date_to; page passes only VIN at lines 218-219. Invalidates existing session keys and emits success/error toasts. Page additionally identifies 403.
dataSources.backendLimits: No mutation performed. Router declares a five-per-minute IP rate limit; actual account/auth/import behavior unverified.

dataSources.name: Vehicle scope
dataSources.behavior: Existing VIN bridge consumes shared selected vehicle; vin=* provides fleet override and legacy VIN bookmarks are reconciled. Required local Select remains because this route disables the header vehicle selector.

dataSources.name: Wait sites
dataSources.behavior: Independent historical query with cancellation; mounted WaitOraclePanel supplies no session VIN or analysis-window scope.

dataSources.name: Wait forecast
dataSources.behavior: Independent historical query enabled for a nonempty site. Arrival defaults to now; local datetime is converted to ISO; forecast displays UTC hour evidence.

dataSources.name: Display preferences, range and trust
dataSources.hook: useRangeState, useSettings, useUnits, useFormatting, useNumberFormatting, useDataState, useOperationalMetrics
dataSources.behavior: Header-owned range, user currency/locale/precision, SI energy display and historical trust adapter. Preference endpoint internals were not traversed; no additional endpoint claimed.

components.role: Existing page orchestration, query context and four titled detail panels; preserve contextActions and primaryAction.

components.name: OperationalBrief, ChargingSummaryBrief and useOperationalMetrics
components.role: Two intentionally different evidence scopes: four analysis-window metrics and five lifetime-summary metrics; both reuse canonical OperationalBrief.

components.name: DataTable
components.role: Sole table pipeline: nine columns, mobile cards/full details, filtering, sorting, column preferences, pagination, virtualization, export and multiselection.

components.name: ChartContainer and chart category components
components.role: Monthly cost chart, accessible data-column input, retry and export; WaitOraclePanel separately uses this frame.

components.name: MetricBar
components.role: Existing reusable charger-energy and top-site-cost breakdown renderer; no replacement composite needed.

components.name: WaitOraclePanel
components.role: Independent site and arrival selection, forecast summary, evidence and hourly chart.

components.name: TeslaChargingSessionsMap
components.role: Lazy, finite-coordinate-filtered clustered map with centroid, tile layer, popup content and marker labels.

components.name: UI, feedback and motion primitives
components.role: Badge, GlassPanel, Button, Select, Text, Code, skeletons, QueryError, EmptyState, StaleRefreshWarning, DataStateNotice and FadeIn are existing owners; shared internals not audited.

duplicatedPatterns.fix: Extract a feature-local typed presentation adapter only for identical display mappings; retain all raw export schemas and canonical DataTable ownership.

duplicatedPatterns.detail: Lifetime-summary and scoped operational metric definitions overlap, but their periods and sources differ explicitly at lines 773-778.
duplicatedPatterns.fix: Reuse existing metrics/brief owners and share only genuinely identical formatter definitions; do not merge scopes or discard either brief.

issues.detail: role=application introduces a specialist keyboard/screen-reader interaction obligation. Map-local popup access, focus and full point alternatives have not been exercised; the page table is a useful parallel record view, not proof of map accessibility.
issues.fix: Validate existing map/cluster keyboard and popup ownership with real assistive interaction; use ordinary semantics unless application-mode behavior is demonstrated, preserving all points and popup data.

issues.detail: Forecast verdict is rendered as raw API enum text; the duration helper on the page emits literal h/m suffixes at lines 78-80 rather than locale-aware duration labels.
issues.fix: Localize displayed verdicts and duration units through existing catalogs/formatters while preserving source enum values, UTC evidence and duration behavior.

sourceEvidence: Session trust uses historical useDataState, fatalError and retained-data-aware loading at lines 148-152.
StaleRefreshWarning and unavailable/offline-blocked DataStateNotice remain above sections at lines 675-681; fatal QueryError has refetch at lines 683-684.
Each chart/breakdown/map/table section has initial skeleton, error/retry and empty/unresolved messaging; lazy map has Suspense geometry at lines 887-893.
Summary brief receives retained and independent lifetime scope at lines 773-778.
Refresh action exposes mutation pending; business-account 403 has attention and visible account note. Other mutation errors are handled by the hook toast, not a claimed inline error panel.
Oracle site and forecast have independent loading/fatal retries and no-sites empty state at WaitOraclePanel.tsx:148-170.

issues.detail: Independent sites/forecast states only surface initial loading and fatalError; no refreshError/isRefreshBlocked/stale warning is rendered beside retained forecast. A successful null forecast ends in null at line 244.
issues.fix: Reuse StaleRefreshWarning/DataStateNotice for each independent oracle source and give resolved-unavailable forecast an explicit nonzero-preserving state. Do not replace retained forecast on refresh failure.

issues.detail: Energy/cost aggregation and narrative energy coalesce absent measurements to zero (groupSessions 117-119, monthly cost 94, totals 236-238, evidence 313). Missing cost counts are flagged, but all-missing energy/cost can still produce measured-looking zero; oracle absent wait similarly becomes zero at WaitOraclePanel.tsx:90,176.
issues.fix: Retain valid zero, track coverage separately and mark unknown/partial totals and hourly values. Preserve every record and existing formulas pending explicit domain review rather than inventing missing measurements.

issues.detail: Operational status falls through to Awaiting data when source is unresolved but not loading/fatal (e.g. refresh blocked); narrative still derives zero sessions/energy/cost and no-immediate-response wording from absent payload.
issues.fix: Use actual unavailable/offline/retained/partial trust state in brief status and narrative; retain surrounding sections and independent oracle rather than blanket-gating the page.

states.validation: No source loading, retained refresh, offline, 403, mutation, null payload or extreme-data scenario was executed.

visualIssues.detail: Monthly chart fixes a bright cyan #22d3ee gradient instead of current palette. Companion map fixes the same marker color at TeslaChargingSessionsMap.tsx:127.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing theme-aware restrained chart/map palette at the caller boundary; preserve gradient/frame/series and saved explicit palette preferences.

visualIssues.detail: Ordinary energy, peak and cost body values are assigned cyan/amber/emerald-300 at lines 465,477,502, regardless of severity. Cyan decorative icons repeat at lines 840,878,907. These are subdued relative to neon but remain unnecessary fixed saturated accents across themes.
visualIssues.fix: Use canonical primary/secondary typography for ordinary measurements and reserve semantic hue for actual warning/status; keep business prerequisite warning meanings and user chart palette.

visualIssues.detail: Four hardcoded saturated rose/amber/blue/green chart fills express busyness thresholds without theme palette ownership; thresholds have meaning and cannot simply be flattened away.
visualIssues.fix: Map the existing four busyness bands to restrained canonical severity/chart tokens; preserve thresholds, badges, numeric evidence and non-color alternatives.

visualIssues.detail: Popup HTML contains ad-hoc text-xs/font-semibold and literal inline line-height/margin, outside typography roles. Site/charger/date strings are escaped in current source.
visualIssues.fix: Retain popup fields and escaping, styling through the existing map popup owner/tokens; do not create a second HTML/popup engine.

architectureIssues.detail: Header range is registered, but the page consumes only date strings and constructs local inclusive day bounds at lines 162-168. Exact rolling startInstant/endInstantExclusive are ignored, and sessions read hook supplies no server bounds. This cannot preserve a true rolling 24h/live window or prove full-range result completeness.
architectureIssues.fix: Consume precise shared instants, pass both through the existing typed session hook/query key, and coordinate real backend support before claiming full-range filtering. Keep lifetime summary explicitly independent and retain local VIN selection on this vehicle-disabled route.

architectureIssues.detail: Costs from rows with distinct currency_code are summed without grouping/conversion and displayed in user currency. Table correctly uses row currency at lines 503-505, but monthly cost, narrative, top locations and map popup use user formatting; monthly accessible column says Total ($) at line 802. Actual mixed-currency payload was not observed.
architectureIssues.fix: Preserve source currency identity and flag unsupported mixed-currency aggregation; use existing currencyFormat for per-record values. Coordinate authoritative aggregate currency semantics without inventing exchange rates or deleting analytics.

architectureIssues.detail: Current typed session/summary contract still contains peak_power_kw, max_charge_rate_kw and per_kwh_rate/avg_cost_per_kwh. Page multiplies summary peak kW by 1000 for metric rawValue at line 645, but table/CSV retain source fields. Backend semantic unit truth is unverified.
architectureIssues.fix: Coordinate SI contract owner before any rename/conversion; preserve raw current values and export units until the authoritative wire/cache migration is established. Do not cosmetically rename fields or add a dual-shape adapter.

architectureIssues.detail: 1046-line orchestrator exports pure duration/group/monthly derivations and embeds narrative, aggregate, table and export logic. Existing shared presentation owners already cover frames/stats/table.
architectureIssues.fix: Extract feature-local typed derivations and presentation adapters without changing grouping/top-six/monthly/date/export semantics; use existing owners rather than new universal wrappers.

priority.reason: Resolve exact date scope, currency identity and unavailable/partial trust before presentation adoption; palette and orchestration cleanup are P2. No runtime defect or visual acceptance claim is made.
